title: A rational chart in a strict-local ring
statement: Let $K$ be a field, $Y$ a finite-type $K$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-over-base], [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. Put $y=s(\operatorname{closedPoint}\Omega)$ and $B=\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{Y,s}$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. There exist an affine open $U$ containing $y$, a commutative domain $K$-algebra $R$, maps $r:R\to\Gamma(U)$ and $a:\Gamma(U)\to B$, and a $\operatorname{Frac}(R)$-algebra structure on $B$. The ring $B$ is nonzero. The map $\operatorname{Spec}a$ followed by the canonical affine isomorphism and $U\hookrightarrow Y$ is the strict-local structural map [def-weil-affine-spectrum], [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. The composite $a r$ is the composite $R\to\operatorname{Frac}(R)\to B$. The canonical $K$-scalar map $K\to\Gamma(U)\to B$ is $K\to\operatorname{Frac}(R)\to B$. Finally $\operatorname{trdeg}_K\operatorname{Frac}(R)=\operatorname{trdeg}_K\kappa(y)$ [def-kun-transcendence-degree], [def-weil-residue-field].

proof.text: Choose a finite transcendence basis of the finite-type residue field at y. Lift its finitely many elements through stalk residues and germs, and choose a common affine neighbourhood U. Let R be the polynomial ring over K on these lifted functions. Algebraic independence makes its residue evaluation injective, including for an empty basis.

proof.text: The strict-local ring B is nonzero and local, with closed point mapping to y. Every point of Spec B generalizes its closed point; thus the structural morphism factors through U. Affine-spectrum full faithfulness supplies a and identifies its scalar map.

source.place: Tag 0F0U, lemma-strictly-henselian, proof before the compatible-model footnote; Tag 0F0X, lemma-interlude-I, second paragraph

proof.text: Every nonzero polynomial in the lifts has nonzero residue, hence is a unit in B. Localization extends the polynomial evaluation uniquely to FractionRing R. Its defining equations give both scalar compatibilities. The size of the transcendence basis computes both transcendence degrees.

theorem exists_strictLocal_rational_chart
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of K))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of K))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of K))]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y) :
    ∃ U : Y.Opens, s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) ∈ U ∧
      ∃ hU : IsAffineOpen U,
      ∃ (R : Type u) (_ : CommRing R) (_ : IsDomain R) (_ : Algebra K R)
        (r : CommRingCat.of R ⟶ Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤))
        (a : Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤) ⟶ strictHenselizationRing s)
        (_ : Algebra (FractionRing R) (strictHenselizationRing s)),
        Nontrivial (strictHenselizationRing s) ∧
        Spec.map a ≫ (@Scheme.isoSpec U.toScheme hU).inv ≫ U.ι =
          strictHenselizationStructuralMap s ∧
        (r ≫ a).hom = (algebraMap (FractionRing R) (strictHenselizationRing s)).comp
          (algebraMap R (FractionRing R)) ∧
        ((ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv ≫ (U.ι ≫ (Y ↘ Spec (.of K))).appTop ≫ a).hom =
          (algebraMap (FractionRing R) (strictHenselizationRing s)).comp
            (algebraMap K (FractionRing R)) ∧
        Algebra.trdeg K (FractionRing R) =
          @Algebra.trdeg K (Y.residueField (s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))) _ _
            (((Y ↘ Spec (.of K)).residueFieldAlgebraMap
              (s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))).toAlgebra)
